about: PubChem (NCBI) open chemistry database. This CLI searches compounds, genes, bioassays and literature, runs structure searches, fetches compound, gene, assay and element records, exports 2D/3D structures, and browses the periodic table, classification trees and data sources.

commands.summary: Keyword search of PubChem compounds (name, synonym, formula, etc.) with sorting and paging

params.name: q
params.description: Search keyword, e.g. a compound name, synonym or formula. Do not include double quotes.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order as 'field,dir'. Examples: relevancescore,desc; cid,asc; complexity,desc; mw,asc; mw,desc; annothitcnt,desc

params.name: start
params.description: 1-based index of the first row. Page 2 with limit 10 is start=11.

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Rows per page (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.summary: Keyword search of PubChem gene targets

params.name: q
params.description: Search keyword (gene symbol, name, related term)

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Rows per page (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.summary: Keyword search of literature (PubMed articles) linked to PubChem records

params.name: sort

params.name: api_limit

commands.summary: Count keyword hits in every PubChem collection (compound, substance, bioassay, gene, protein, taxonomy, pathway, cell, literature, patent)
Run an identity, similarity, substructure, superstructure or 3D-similarity search seeded by a compound CID. Returns the hit count and a cache key.

params.name: cid
params.description: PubChem Compound ID used as the query structure

commands.summary: Resolve a chemical name or identifier to PubChem records (preferred CID, RefChem); also reports whether the input is valid SMILES, SMARTS, InChI, etc.
Autocomplete suggestions for compound, gene or taxonomy names from a prefix

params.name: dictionary
params.description: Dictionary to suggest from. Comma-separated lists such as compound,gene are also accepted.

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Maximum suggestions per dictionary (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.summary: Full PubChem compound summary record (names, identifiers, properties, safety, pharmacology, etc.) by CID

params.name: heading
params.description: Optional TOC heading that limits the record to one section, e.g. 'Melting Point' or 'IUPAC Name'

params.name: record_type
params.description: 2d for a 2D depiction, 3d for the computed 3D conformer

params.name: start

params.description: Number of child levels to return
